request: build the release workflow and release a build of both PRs for testing; mirror the rhythm release workflow

criteria.text: Manual dispatch accepts a release label and qualification-only input, testing-tag bootstrap exists, and pull requests run read-only validation without signing or publishing.
criteria.test_id: release-c1: dispatch, testing-tag, and read-only pull-request triggers are available

criteria.text: Manual and tracking sources are full pinned SHAs from this repository.
criteria.test_id: release-c2: release variants use the full pinned manual and tracking source commits

criteria.text: Only ARM64 macOS is built; credentials fail closed and never reach dependency installation.
criteria.test_id: release-c3: hosted builds run on native Apple Silicon and install dependencies before scoped signing credentials

criteria.text: The hosted runner keychain is temporary and cleaned even on failure.
criteria.test_id: release-c4: temporary signing keychains are removed by unconditional cleanup

criteria.text: Both signed/notarized DMGs pass packaged checks before a single prerelease publication job.
criteria.test_id: release-c5: both verified installer artifacts feed one prerelease publication job

criteria.text: Qualification-only runs never publish; duplicate releases/assets are refused rather than overwritten.
criteria.test_id: release-c6: qualification-only runs skip publication and existing releases/assets are never overwritten

criteria.text: Malformed release versions and non-full source SHAs are rejected before a build starts.
criteria.test_id: release-c7: invalid release versions and non-full source SHAs are rejected before build

criteria.text: Each asset receipt has byte count, SHA-256, source, release label, embedded app version, and minimum-OS metadata, with no local paths or secrets in the public manifest.
criteria.test_id: release-c8: asset receipts include byte count, SHA-256, source, app version and minimum OS without paths or secrets

criteria.text: Downloaded public asset bytes match their published receipts.
criteria.reason: Requires publication to GitHub followed by downloading both public assets and comparing their bytes and SHA-256 values with the published receipt.

criteria.text: Real-person tracking, clean-OS/TCC, and physical camera/gimbal smoke remain unverified until witnessed.
criteria.reason: Production qualification is outside this testing-release task and remains pending until a clean macOS/TCC run and physical tracking session are witnessed.
